title: Handoff Telegram tile with instructional snippets, SLO micrographs, and cost trail links
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Design a compact 'Telegram' tile that lives in the incident / alert pane and surfaces a short, actionable handoff for the next on‑call responder. The tile combines three compact affordances: 1) instructional snippet (1–2 sentences) written by the current responder, 2) an SLO micrograph (tiny sparkline showing the SLO delta over the last 60m) and 3) a cost-trail link cluster that points to the per-route token cost breakdown for the related alert.

Goals: Reduce friction during shift change, surface actionable context in under 10 seconds, and provide clear links to runbooks/postmortems and cost implications. Keep the chrome minimal so the tile can be repeated in a horizontal stack for multi-incident views.

Acceptance criteria:
- Designer-approved Figma prototype with desktop and tablet variants.
- Micrograph uses single-color SLO delta encoding (green/orange/red) and includes aria-label text for screen readers.
- Instructional snippet is editable inline (max 280 characters) and autosaves to the incident timeline.
- Cost-trail links open a modal with the console cost-breakdown anchored to the alert rule.
- Hand-off tile is keyboard-navigable and passes WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast for text and sparkline markers.
- Performance: tile renders in under 60ms in the console mock with 100 concurrent tiles.

Design notes and trade-offs considered:
- We evaluated a larger tile with timeline context; rejected because it increased visual weight and pushed other cards below the fold.
- Chose a sparkline micrograph instead of an embedded chart to keep rendering cheap and accessible for low-bandwidth environments.
- Inline editing was prioritized over a separate modal to reduce clicks during urgent handoffs, but we included keyboard shortcuts and an explicit 'revert' action for safety.
- Cost links are intentionally shallow (modal) rather than full navigation to avoid context loss for the on-call user.

Prototype links and artifacts (see attachments): Figma flows for desktop/tablet, prototype interaction notes, and a short Loom walkthrough.

Dev handoff notes:
- Provide a simple JSON payload contract: {"snippet":"string","slo_delta_pct":"number","alert_rule_id":"string"} (see dev-spec doc).
- Frontend needs a lightweight sparkline component (SVG) with aria-label and color mapping helper.
- Backend requires an endpoint for saving snippet drafts and returning the latest SLO delta; caching strategy recommended.

Metrics for success:
- Reduction in average time-to-first-action by next responder by 20% on incidents where a Telegram tile was present.
- 75% of tiles populated (non-empty snippet) for incidents handled by teams in pilot.
- No accessibility regressions on Lighthouse audit.
